subject: Quick Signal: OKR crosswalk, runway risks & QBR dry-run items
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Executive Leadership <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-cs <cs@acme-corp.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick Signal: OKR crosswalk, runway risks & QBR dry-run items

Team — sending a compact weekly signal ahead of next week's QBR dry run. Purpose: align on a small set of asks so the dry run stays under 45 minutes and surfaces only decision-grade issues. High level below (wins | runway risks | asks). Attached: one-pager QBR agenda + OKR crosswalk.

Wins:
- Dedicated throughput improvements (v2 scheduler) live in prod can reduce tail latency by ~15% on gen-heavy workloads — validated on internal benchmark.
- Two mid-market deals (EMEA region) moved from POC to negotiation — sales expects signatures next quarter.

Runway risks (what could cause hiccups):
- One key quantization path shows a regression for long-history chat prompts (edge case). Eng team has a patch but needs an extra CI cycle to validate against regression suite (ETA Tue).
- Dedicated capacity GPU inventory shortfalls in eu-west could press routing to hosted fallback if not mitigated during the QBR week.

Asks (prioritized):
1) Soojin — can your ops team confirm the eu-west reserved pool replenishment plan by EOD Mon? If not, we should scope a contingency slide.
2) Hannah — please bring the customer-impact summary (1 slide) for the quantization regression so we can decide rollback vs targeted mitigation in the dry run.
3) Laura/Jonas — confirm the decision owners for the two mid-market contract escalations; we need authority to approve one-off discount windows during QBR.

I'll run a 30-min dry-run Tue 10am PT (calendar invite sent). If we keep to the asks above we can keep the exec session tight.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR_dryrun_agenda.pdf (1 page), OKR_crosswalk.xlsx (sheet: Signal->Decisions)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Executive Leadership <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Thanks Marcus — quick updates on the regression:
- We repro the regression on the nightly perf harness for one model-family (rlm-34b) when sequence length >4k and kv-cache hits are frequent.
- Fix candidate in review (PR #6421). CI run started; preliminary results look promising but one flaky test remains (memory overlap on A100 80GB).
- Impact assessment draft attached to this reply (see excerpt below) — if the flaky test persists we recommend a limited rollback for the affected model-family during the QBR window to avoid customer-facing variance.

Ask from Eng: Please approve an expedited CI slot (Mon night) to finish validation. We need sign-off for the slot since it will consume reserved cluster time.

Cheers,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment: impact_excerpt.txt

Regarding the CI slot — approved. I've allocated the Mon night expedited window for validation; please keep the run scope to the regression test matrix only.

Added: I uploaded a compact contingency slide to the Drive folder (link below) that outlines fallback routing + customer communication bullets. Put it on the dry-run deck under 'Ops contingencies'.

Thanks for the crisp signal — appreciated. Short replies to the asks: 
- Jonas and I will be the decision owners on the two mid-market contract exceptions. If sales needs a one-off discount window we will evaluate case-by-case; please route specifics to me + Jonas with the proposed concession and rationale before Tue EOD.
- Hannah: approved for expedited CI slot (noting impact on reserved cluster). If the flaky test remains, proceed with the rollback recommendation and prepare a customer communication blurb we can push to CS.
- Soojin: thanks for the pool work and contingency slide; please surface a single-line status in the dry-run slide deck.

I'll join the Tue 10am dry-run and will be prepared to decide on the two contract asks. Marcus — please keep the agenda tight and start with the regression decision node so we have margin to discuss contract items.

Laura Bennett
Chief Operating Officer
Redwood Inference
